## JARVIS Shop v2 - Rangéo store manager
**Every 10 minutes:** new Shopify orders -> Telegram alert (items, total, estimated profit, city) + memory (screen and briefing see it).
**Every day 8:45:** paid orders not shipped after 4 days -> one alert. Silent when all is fine.
Shopify key: Custom Auth credential **Rangéo Shopify app** in *Shopify token* (Dev Dashboard app client ID + secret; JARVIS gets a fresh 24 h token itself). **JARVIS Telegram** in both Send nodes. New product? Add its CJ SKU and cost (USD, product + shipping) to COSTS in *Format order*. Replaces Shop v1.
